label: Walk Away with a Smile: B

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: These petulant children are becoming easier to deal with.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: Or could it perhaps be that I've become stronger?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Let's hurry! We can't leave her on her own!
Countless pillars of light plummet down from the air.
The light beams strike the ground, causing earth-shattering tremors.
As the dust settles, a being covered in silver reveals itself.
Devoid of any discernible emotion, it stands wordlessly before the Goddess squad.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: My most sincere apologies for speaking so frankly upon our first meeting, but I shall claim your head!
Scarlet's sword clatters against Anachiro's shield.
Snow White unleashes a simultaneous barrage from the Seven Dwarves.
and conjures up a protective barrier that covers her entirely.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: Is this all a joke to you? Let's see if you find this humorous!
Scarlet brandishes her sword and swings it several times at Anachiro.
Anachiro maneuvers her shields with remarkable agility, blocking every single one of Scarlet's strikes.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: It's testing us. It wants to see how strong it is.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: That's why it came down for a direct confrontation instead of blowing us away.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: And it's determined we're not much of a threat.
Anachiro's shields fan out in a circle,

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: Oh, so you no longer have any need for your shields, do you?

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: Such hubris will be your downfall!
When Cinderella disappeared, her customized weapon, the Glass Slippers went missing as well.
These remarkable shields they are witnessing are no doubt that very weapon.
There is very little that could possibly have greater defensive capabilities than a self-mobilizing shield.
But how has she acquired the ability to transmute objects? How has she transformed her defensive armor into an offensive weapon?
No matter how hard she looks, she cannot find where the fusillade of beams are being emitted from.
Snow White shifts her attention towrads the surrounding shields.
The heat sinks are exposed, and the material on the surface of the shields seems as if it were made of a smooth, glass-like material.
Highly appropriate, considering the moniker given to the weapon: Glass Slippers.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Everyone, step back from the direction the shields are facing!
There is a glimmer on Anachiro's bracelet, and a beam shoots out.
Once the beam makes contact with the shield, it diffuses into several beams, which then bounce back with rapid speed.
The Goddess Squad is engulfed by this barrage of light.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Did... Did I get them all?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Those morons! Why didn't anyone come to help?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Phew... I'm pooped... I've gotta rest for a moment.
Red Hood takes off at a full sprint.
Everything is in complete disarray, and the ground itself is smoldering.
On the ground lie her squadmates, unconscious.
Red Hood can feel the anger welling up inside her.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I don't see anyone else here.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: You think I ran all the way over here just for a sneak peek of you all passed out?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: You all oughta be ashamed of yourselves.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Get up and fight alongside me, you fools!
Red Hood puts on her coat.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Yes, you're still among the living.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Was my corruption removed? I feel like I've been cured.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: How come the Boss and Lilith aren't here?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: They... had to leave for a moment.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Why didn't you tell us you were alive?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Oh, you know, one thing happened, and then another.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You up and disappear without a trace, and that's the only explanation you can offer?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You're lucky everything worked out like it did. What if you'd been accidentally hit by friendly fire or something?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: If one of you managed to plug my bright red ass by mistake, that'd be on you.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: Did you vanquish the corruption completely?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: More like we decided to call a truce.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: I have good news for you. Our latest research shows that cryogenic sleep can put a temporary stop to corruption.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Would you be willing to give that...

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: That only works during the initial stages of the corruption process, though. Isn't that right?
Snow White hesitantly shuffles towards Red Hood.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Since when did you become so yellow-bellied?
Red Hood reaches out her arm,
and puts Snow White in a headlock.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I'm sorry for lying to you.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I should have given you a proper farewell,

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I'm sorry for all those terrible things I said to you.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I was just really upset that you were leaving me behind...

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I understand you better than anyone else here.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Forget it. It's all in the past.
Red Hood releases Snow White and backs up a few steps.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Now, I've come to do it right.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: No matter how much I try and convince myself otherwise, in my heart I know that I can't be beside you guys.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: So I've come to say goodbye for real this time.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Things will be a lot quieter once you're gone.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Are you saying you didn't like being around me 'cause I was noisy?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: If you weren't blaring that old music all the time, it'd be a bit more bearable.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I've told you: some things get better with age.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: We shall meet again one day.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Nah, you're not going where I'm going just yet. You're gonna live a long and fruitful life.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Just watch that temper of yours.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Have you got Blinding Passion: Volume 2?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Sure, just open the inside zipper of my bag.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Ah, so that's where it's been.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: I've been wanting to... further my education, but I suppose I'll have to do that on my own.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Best of luck in becoming an expert in the field!

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: You're gonna end up corrupted for sure.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Send my regards to Boss and Lilith too.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: Can you see her off with a smile?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I have been working on the weapon you asked me to make.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: And I will keep working on it.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Make sure to come get it when it's done.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Uh... I don't know what to say.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Did you have a fun time knowing me?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: for accepting me as one of your own, even if I was just a nobody.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I appreciate you working hard to make sure I never felt left out.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: The time I've spent with you, and all those close calls on the battlefield,

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: were some of the best moments of my life.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: and even more, that I could spend all that time with you.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: It was an honor fighting together with you.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: It was an honor for me too!
Red Hood turns around and walks off.
This time, she has not a frown, but a contented smile on her face.
The savory scent of the bakery.
to the sky above our hometown.
in the earth under our hometown.
